description: This file contains functions for transforming, serializing, and deserializing diff and commit rows, converting them to various formats, handling SQL row scans, and computing hashes, all within the context of a repository analysis tool.

methods.name: CSVLineToDiffRow
methods.description: Converts a CSV line represented as string array into a DiffRow entity, with error handling for invalid length and value conversions.

methods.name: CSVLineToCommitRow
methods.description: Converts a CSV line into a CommitRow entity, validating the number of columns.

methods.name: batchToInts
methods.description: Converts a variable number of string inputs into integers, returning an error if any conversion fails.

methods.name: diffRowToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Transforms an analyzed diff row into a denormalized database row format for reporting purposes.

methods.name: commitRowToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Transforms an analyzed commit row into a denormalized database row format for reporting, including author tech area.

methods.name: diffRowToPersistCols
methods.description: Converts an analyzed diff row into a set of database columns suitable for persistence, including UUID and timestamp.

methods.name: commitRowToPersistCols
methods.description: Converts an analyzed commit row into a set of database columns for persistence, including UUID and timestamp.

methods.name: DiffRowsToPersistCols
methods.description: Converts a list of analyzed diff rows into a list of database rows with UUIDs for persistence, using a common timestamp.

methods.name: DiffRowsToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Converts a list of analyzed diff rows into denormalized format for reporting.

methods.name: CommitRowsToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Converts a list of analyzed commit rows into denormalized format, associated with their timestamps.

methods.name: DiffRowsToAggregateChangesOverTime
methods.description: Aggregates diff rows over time to produce summary metrics with a timestamp.

methods.name: getSumOfAttribute
methods.description: Sums a specific attribute over a list of diff rows based on a provided getter function.

methods.name: CommitRowsToPersistCols
methods.description: Persist analyzed commit rows by generating rows with UUIDs and timestamps.

methods.name: SQLRowToDiffRow
methods.description: Scans a SQL row into an analyzed diff row object, converting timestamps and handling binary UUIDs.

methods.name: SQLRowToCommitRow
methods.description: Scans a SQL row into an analyzed commit row, converting timestamps and UUIDs.

methods.name: PrependMappedDiffTarget
methods.description: Adds upstream and downstream target info to denormalized diff rows.

methods.name: AppendDiffTarget
methods.description: Appends diff target information to rows for reporting purposes.

methods.name: SHA256HexDigest
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of a string and returns its hex representation.

methods.name: GetAuthorTechArea
methods.description: Determines the technical area associated with an author's email by hashing and mapping to known indices.
